Beyond that, the entry flags strong data governance, compliance automation, and good for privacy-primary orgs, governance and dependency notes rather than technical specifications.

profile_text.body:
OneTrust is an Atlanta, Georgia company founded in 2016 that describes itself as helping companies manage privacy, consent, and AI governance while automating compliance and reducing risk. Its site frames the work as connecting privacy, data, AI, and technology risk in one continuous system, so that organizations can define purpose, automate assessments, enforce controls, and monitor new risks across domains.

Its tracked product is OneTrust AI Governance, listed under AI governance and risk management platforms, with a note describing a privacy-first approach, strong data governance, and compliance automation suited to privacy-primary organizations. The site markets the OneTrust AI-Ready Governance Platform and says it gives a continuous, real-time view of how data and AI are used. It also carries a customer account from GOL Trust for Aviation, which describes connecting databases with OneTrust and finding seven billion IDs in its storage database, and cites third party management, risk assessments, a library of risk, and compliance and governance as reasons for the choice.

The litigation record for OneTrust shows exposure in Georgia, with 105 cases.
